Accenture Defence Addressable Market Dashboard

Executive Summary

This dashboard provides an executive view of Accenture's addressable Defence market . It shows the size of the opportunity, Accenture's historical position, the service offerings where demand is concentrated, and the suppliers currently winning the work.

The headline KPI cards summarise market scale and Accenture's share. The addressable-market overview explains the relationship between total procurement, Accenture-addressable work and competitor-owned opportunity. The service-offering view identifies the largest areas of demand and where Accenture has the strongest or weakest market penetration.
